exposure: Women who delivered via cesarean section
outcome: all-cause maternal mortality within six weeks
all-cause maternal mortality within one year after childbirth
cohort: 3,334,663 nulliparous women in South Korea from the Korean National Health Insurance Service database between 2003 and 2018
finding: South Korean primiparas with lower income levels had a higher risk of maternal death within six weeks and one year after childbirth.
mod_finding: Women who delivered via cesarean section had a higher risk of maternal death.
